699a80908991ef784965077b description:
You’ve been operating quietly. No noise, no unnecessary bodies, no attention. That doesn’t go unnoticed — not by the right people.

There’s a man tracking supply movement across Tarkov. Not a trader. Not exactly. He funds operations that stay invisible and rewards people who understand discretion. Lately, he’s been watching the same routes you’ve been moving through. That means you’ve stepped into something structured.

He wants proof you can move valuable equipment without disturbing the system around it. Deliver the electronics to the old bunker on Woods. No fighting. No chaos. Just clean work.

If he’s satisfied, I’ll make the introduction.
699a80908991ef784965077b successMessageT: Efficient. Clean. That’s what he wanted to see. I passed your name along. Don’t make me regret it.
699a80908991ef784965077b startedMessageT: The bunker is isolated. Perfect for quiet work. Leave the equipment intact and unseen.
699a80908991ef784965077b completePlayerM: Everything is in place. No noise, no witnesses.
699a80908991ef784965077b failMessageText: You were told to keep it quiet. Attention like that gets people removed from the equation.

69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa description:
That investor you impressed? He’s not the only one watching.

I’ve been picking up fragments — signal bleed, movement logs, partial records. Not random. Structured. Clean enough that it shouldn’t exist anymore.

Someone rebuilt something under everyone’s nose.

You’ve been moving through it.

That makes you useful.

I don’t need the whole system. Just something I can read, trace, and sell. Routes, timing, access points — anything that turns structure into opportunity.

You bring me a clean extract, and I’ll turn it into leverage. Quietly.

No one needs to know where it came from.
69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa startedMessageT: I want it clean, readable, and worth my time.
69d8db4a3b45af4d32ab83fa successMessageT: Good. This is real structure. Enough to make the right people nervous.
